title.zh: 更改达沃省Padada市镇若干学校名称的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Names of Certain Schools in the Municipality of Padada, Province of Davao
title.orig: An Act Changing the Names of Certain Schools in the Municipality of Padada, Province of Davao

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1957/ra_1731_1957.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
The names of the following schools in the Municipality of Padada, Province of Davao, are changed as follows:
1. Padada Elementary School to Northern Padada Elementary School, and
2. Roosevelt Elementary School to Padada Central Elementary School.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 21, 1957.
